category_title: Children with ASD experiencing difficulties in social interaction and perspective-taking
scenario_title: Independent participation in structured philosophical dialogue
minimal_context: The student is participating in a whole-class verbal discussion about a stimulus passage while sitting in a circle.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We are going to talk about the stimulus passage we just read. Please share your thoughts with the circle.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I think the story is... well, I want to make a point about the main character, but... (looks over at a classmate who is whispering).

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: What do you want to say about the character?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: He was wrong. I mean, I find it easier to get on with people when I use philosophy and just the agreeing and disagreeing in general, but I don't know how to structure what I want to say right now.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just go ahead and tell us why you think he was wrong.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I can't think when they keep trying to distract me! I don't have my support assistant here to help me stay on task. I can't cope with this right now, I'm removing myself from the session.
